calculation.expression: cross_sectional_demean(sign * rolling_sum(asset_return,5)), sign = -1 if lagged rolling_sum(DXY_return,20) / rolling_std(DXY_return,60) > 0 else +1
calculation.description: Uses the lagged DXY trend state to condition five-day cross-asset momentum; dollar-positive trend reverses the momentum orientation, while other states retain it. Signal is lagged one session to avoid look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Positive aggregate result across a small 15-instrument cross-asset universe; 1-day IC was stronger but did not meet the ICIR gate, while the 10-day horizon met both admission thresholds. Interpret uncertainty conservatively.
